issues.issue: Are Westshore's lease payments 'fees' subject to the fairness and non-discrimination rules of ss. 49-50 of the Canada Marine Act?
issues.applicant_position: Lease payments are fees under s. 53, so the fair, reasonable and non-discriminatory requirements of ss. 49-50 apply.
issues.respondent_position: Lease payments are not fees for the reasons below; even if they are, they are agreed fees under s. 53.
issues.result_quote: we are of the view that even if lease payments are fees, they fall under section 53.

issues.issue: Do the requirements of ss. 49-52 apply to fees agreed under s. 53?
issues.applicant_position: Sections 49-52 apply to any fee, including agreed fees, so unjust-discrimination relief is available.
issues.respondent_position: Agreed fees under s. 53 fall outside ss. 49-52, and no regulatory relief applies to them.
issues.result_quote: when fees are agreed upon according to section 53, the requirements of sections 49 to 52 are not applicable.

issues.issue: Can the Court grant the rental-rate relief sought in the judicial review application (question 5)?
issues.applicant_position: The Court should remit the rental rates for redetermination and grant the broad relief sought after paragraph 57.
issues.result_quote: The answer to question 5 is that the Court cannot grant the relief as set out in the particulars following paragraph 57 of the judicial review application.
